An object is rotated in a horizontal circle of radius m at constant speed. The magnitude of the resultant force on the object is N. What is the work done on the object by the resultant force during a quarter of a revolution and what is the direction of the resultant force?

Work done by the resultant force on the object

Direction of resultant force
A. J Towards the centre of the circle
B. J Tangent to the circle
C. Zero Towards the centre of the circle
D. Zero Tangent to the circle
